# Desmus Design

> > Desmus Design specializes in cultural architecture, performance venue design, and acoustic engineering for theaters, congress centers, museums, and public buildings across Turkey and internationally.

Based in Istanbul, Desmus Cultural Architecture delivers comprehensive design services including acoustics, AVL systems, stage engineering, and building code compliance for cultural institutions. Notable projects include the Sivriada Congress and Culture Center, Adnan Menderes Democracy and Freedom Island, and venues in Ankara, Kinshasa, and Muscat.

## Key Topics

- Cultural Architecture
- Acoustic Design & Solutions
- Performance Systems & AVL Design
- Theater & Auditorium Design
- Congress Centers

- Istanbul & Ankara Projects
- Building Code Compliance

- Sivriada Island
- Adnan Menderes Democracy Island

## Featured Projects

- [Projects | Desmus](https://www.desmusdesign.com/projects): Portfolio of Desmus cultural centers, theaters & performance venues
- [Sivriada Congress and Culture Center | Desmus](https://www.desmusdesign.com/sivriada-congressand-culture-center): Congress & culture center project on Sivriada Island, Istanbul, Turkey
- [Adnan Menderes Democracy and Freedom Island | Desmus](https://www.desmusdesign.com/adnan-menderes-democracy-and-freedom-island): Democracy museum & congress center at Yassıada Island, Istanbul
- [AFAD Operation Center | Desmus Cultural Architecture | İstanbul](https://www.desmusdesign.com/afad-operation-center): National disaster & emergency operations center for Turkish government
- [Court of Cassation Conference Hall | Desmus](https://www.desmusdesign.com/court-of-cassation-conference-hall): Conference hall for Turkish Court of Cassation in Ankara
- [Congress Center Kinshasa | Desmus](https://www.desmusdesign.com/congress-center-kinshasa): Congress center project in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of Congo
- [Uskudar Municipality – Red Hall | Desmus Cultural Architecture | İstanbul](https://www.desmusdesign.com/uskudar-municipality-redhall): Red Hall multipurpose auditorium for Uskudar Municipality, Istanbul
